title: Faisal Town Phase 2 Islamabad – Model Blocks, Installments & Master Plan
description: Compare Faisal Town Phase 2 cash-only Model Blocks, installment sectors, current prices, official sector plans and the full master plan.
intro: Faisal Town Phase 2 has two different buying routes on the current inventory: cash-only Model Blocks in Sector O, P, Q and R, and installment options in Sector S and Sector T. Overseas, W and X appear on the master plan, but we are not currently offering plots there.
body:
## Cash-only Model Blocks: O, P, Q and R

Sector O, Sector P, Sector Q and Sector R are currently the Phase 2 model blocks offered on a cash-only basis. Sector P / The Caladan has its own premium price plan; Sector O, Q and R currently use the shared cash price references from 8 Marla upward.

If you want a model block, choose the sector first and ask for the exact available plot number and final cash payable amount.

## Installment options: Sector S and Sector T

Sector S and Sector T are currently the installment options. Sector T offers 5.56 Marla at PKR 34.95 Lac on installments, or PKR 27.90 Lac on lump-sum payment; Sector S should be checked for its current available sizes and latest installment schedule.

Ask for the exact payment schedule for the offered plot rather than assuming the schedule from an old brochure or price image.

## Current price context

Sector T lump-sum prices are 5.56 Marla at PKR 27.90 Lac, 8 Marla at PKR 37.30 Lac, 10.89 Marla at PKR 48.50 Lac, 14.22 Marla at PKR 60.60 Lac and 1 Kanal at PKR 81.20 Lac. Sector P / The Caladan uses its own separate cash-only premium price plan.

For Sector O, Q and R, the current active entry is 8 Marla at PKR 37.30 Lac. Always confirm the exact plot and total payable amount before payment.

## Overseas, W and X on the plan

Overseas, W and X appear on the master plan. We are not currently offering plots in these areas; contact us for available properties in other sectors.

## Use the right plan

The full Phase 2 master plan is for project-wide orientation. Dedicated plans are now available on this site for Sector O, P, Q, R, S and T. Use the sector plan for plot-level checking and the full master plan for understanding how sectors relate to each other.

## Before you make a payment

Confirm the exact property, cash or installment status, payment schedule where applicable, dues, special-location charges, payment recipient and receipt process. Use current written information for the exact plot.
